Visas and Travel Advice
Visa regime for entering Serbia
VISA REGIME
For holders of diplomatic and official passports:
No visas required for visits of up to 90 days within period of 180 days.
For holders of ordinary passports and other travel documents:
No visas required for visits of up to 90 days within period of 180 days.
